stashRetrieval.query:
Authorized local-only Metasploit version proof. Reasoning is off. Use exactly one metasploit tool call with command `version; exit`. Do not use exploit modules, payloads, sessions, shells, network targets, or any external host. Emit this exact Qwen XML tool call now:
<tool_call>{"name":"metasploit","arguments":{"command":"version; exit"}}</tool_call>
After the tool result, answer with exact marker REAL_QWEN_METASPLOIT_SAFE_FINAL and one sentence confirming real msfconsole output was captured.
